text:
Carla (Auditor): Hi team — auditor request: for the service account `infra-backfill-sa` that was deprovisioned on 2025-08-12, please provide a chain-of-evidence bundle showing the deprovision action, the KMS key rotation (or rekey) that followed, and any vuln/incident tickets tied to that account. We need timestamps, exportable logs, an S3 manifest, and checksums. Deadline EOD next Tue.

Alice (Security): Got it. We'll assemble CloudTrail events + RBAC change record and export.

Ben (Platform): Plan: 1) export CloudTrail events filtered by principal 2) export IAM / K8s rolebindings changes 3) export KMS audit events (ReEncrypt/DisableKey/RotateKey). Will drop artifacts to s3://redwood-compliance/evidence/4301212468/.

Evan (SRE): Adding the deprovision run job output. Devops job id: run-20250812-09f3. Will include job logs and stdout.

Alice (Security): Example commands we'll run for reproducible artifacts: 
```
# cloudtrail lookup
aws cloudtrail lookup-events --lookup-attributes AttributeKey=Username,AttributeValue=infra-backfill-sa --start-time 2025-08-12T00:00:00Z --end-time 2025-08-13T00:00:00Z

# export logs to S3 (one-off)
aws logs create-export-task --log-group-name /aws/infra/backfill --from 1728000000000 --to 1728086400000 --destination redwood-compliance --destination-prefix evidence/4301212468
```

Ben (Platform): For KMS we will include both CloudTrail KMS events and a key metadata snapshot. Sample query: 
```
aws cloudtrail lookup-events --lookup-attributes AttributeKey=EventName,AttributeValue=ReEncrypt --start-time 2025-08-12T00:00:00Z --end-time 2025-08-14T00:00:00Z
```
We'll also export `aws kms describe-key --key-id alias/redwood/prod/infra-backfill` output.

devops-bot: Deprovision job run-20250812-09f3 completed (exit=0). Artifacts uploaded: s3://redwood-compliance/evidence/4301212468/deprov-job.log (sha256: a3b2fced...)

Fiona (Compliance PM): I'll generate the evidence-manifest.json listing objects + sha256 sums and a short attestation doc that engineers can sign. Manifest will live at s3://redwood-compliance/evidence/4301212468/manifest.json

Carla (Auditor): Please ensure the manifest includes: origin of each artifact (CLI vs automated job), UTC timestamps, and who approved the deprovision. Also need proof that any associated KMS key material was rotated or access removed — a signed record is fine.

Alice (Security): We'll include: - CloudTrail export (raw events) - RBAC change git commit and PR link for the cron that removed SA - K8s audit log slices for the delete call - KMS key describe + CloudTrail ReEncrypt/DisableKey events - deprovision job log - Evidence manifest with sha256 + signed attestation (S/MIME sig).

Evan (SRE): Linking vuln/incident: this SA was referenced in INC-2025-324 (vuln triage). I will export the incident ticket export (pdf) and correlate timestamps to the deprov.

Ben (Platform): Putting an example manifest entry: 
```
{
  "path": "s3://redwood-compliance/evidence/4301212468/cloudtrail-infra-backfill.json.gz",
  "sha256": "a3b2fced...",
  "collected_by": "alice@redwood.com",
  "collected_at": "2025-08-12T13:12:00Z",
  "source": "cloudtrail"
}
```

Carla (Auditor): Can you also sign the manifest with a key tied to the Compliance PM or Security lead? Auditor needs non-repudiation.

Fiona (Compliance PM): Yes, I will GPG-sign the manifest and attach the `.asc` signature.

Alice (Security): One ask — we should redact any unrelated personal data before giving artifacts. We'll mark redactions in manifest.

Carla (Auditor): Good. Last bit: please include an audit trace that shows when `infra-backfill-sa` lost all active credentials (tokens/API keys) and the KMS grants referencing it were revoked. That mapping must be explicit.

Ben (Platform): We'll include a CSV mapping: resource, event_ts, event_id, artifact_path. Example rows: `iam-access-key,2025-08-12T09:02:11Z,evt-01,s3://...`

Evan (SRE): I'll attach the deprovision job's exit log and the kube-apiserver audit slice showing the delete call (namespace infra, user=sub:infra-backfill-sa).

Alice (Security): Timeline: we'll aim to drop a zipped evidence bundle + manifest + signature by 2025-08-18T23:59:00Z. Will ping when uploaded.

Carla (Auditor): Thanks — that's perfect. Please ping here when uploaded and include checksums. :+1:

devops-bot: Evidence bundle uploaded: s3://redwood-compliance/evidence/4301212468/evidence-bundle-20250818.zip (sha256: b7f8... ). Signed manifest at s3://redwood-compliance/evidence/4301212468/manifest.json.asc

Fiona (Compliance PM): I signed the manifest and emailed the public key to carla@example-audit.com.

Carla (Auditor): Received. Reviewing now — if anything else comes up I'll flag follow-ups here. Thanks everyone. :white_check_mark:
